title: Home · Climate
description: SwitchBot temperature/humidity sensors indoors, outdoors and around the 3D printer.

targets.query:
import "dict"
names = ["D7353530665A": "Living room", "D63534385106": "Office", "D83535301C43": "Upstairs office", "C76A05062842": "Bedroom", "D7353530520F": "Ada's room", "D83431306571": "Upstairs bathroom", "CE2A82463674": "Downstairs bathroom"]
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -3h, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "tempc")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "D7353530665A" or r.device_id == "D63534385106" or r.device_id == "D83535301C43" or r.device_id == "C76A05062842" or r.device_id == "D7353530520F" or r.device_id == "D83431306571" or r.device_id == "CE2A82463674")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value), place: dict.get(dict: names, key: r.device_id, default: r.device_id)}))
  |> group(columns: ["place"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

  |> last()

import "dict"

panels.title: Outdoor air heated to 22 °C

targets.query:
import "math"
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.device_id == "D83534387029")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "tempc" or r._field == "hum")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.tempc and exists r.hum)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.hum * math.exp(x: 0.0624 * (r.tempc - 22.0))}))
